# GitHubPanel

PR panel: checks, colour-free diff ticks, slide to merge.


## Notes

PR panel for a crew thread's pull request: state chip, display-face title, branch → base pills, checks tray, a colour-free diff tick bar (ink = additions, outlined = deletions), files, and Bencho slide-to-merge (locked until checks pass). Merged = volt chip. @startingPoint section="Panels" subtitle="PR panel with slide-to-merge" viewport="380x680"
